release_content_gate.$comment: Hard release gate for material that must not ship in an App Store archive. Unlike offline_closure (a non-fatal audit of runtime offline invariants), a finding here fails the release assertion. The gate inspects nested ZIP archives because runtime content such as the Pyodide python_stdlib.zip is opaque to a flat file walk. This policy file lives in tools/ and is not copied into the application bundle; it must stay out of any scanned root so that the marker literals below cannot themselves become artifact hits.
